parameters.query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS appointment_post_visit_followups (
    id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,

    appointment_id BIGINT NOT NULL
        REFERENCES appointments(id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE,

    followup_stage TEXT NOT NULL
        CHECK (
            followup_stage IN (
                'first_day',
                'third_day',
                'seventh_day',
                'custom'
            )
        ),

    followup_token TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,

    status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending'
        CHECK (
            status IN (
                'pending',
                'completed',
                'escalated',
                'expired',
                'cancelled'
            )
        ),

    channel TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'whatsapp'
        CHECK (
            channel IN (
                'whatsapp',
                'sms',
                'phone',
                'telegram',
                'web',
                'manual'
            )
        ),

    request_created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    sent_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    expires_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,

    responded_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    recovery_status TEXT
        CHECK (
            recovery_status IS NULL
            OR recovery_status IN (
                'better',
                'same',
                'worse'
            )
        ),

    pain_level INTEGER
        CHECK (
            pain_level IS NULL
            OR pain_level BETWEEN 0 AND 10
        ),

    has_red_flag BOOLEAN,
    red_flag_details TEXT,

    has_medication_issue BOOLEAN,
    medication_issue_details TEXT,

    has_complaint BOOLEAN,
    complaint_details TEXT,

    satisfaction_score INTEGER
        CHECK (
            satisfaction_score IS NULL
            OR satisfaction_score BETWEEN 1 AND 5
        ),

    patient_comment TEXT,

    risk_level TEXT
        CHECK (
            risk_level IS NULL
            OR risk_level IN (
                'low',
                'medium',
                'high',
                'urgent'
            )
        ),

    needs_human_review BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),

    UNIQUE (appointment_id, followup_stage),

    CHECK (expires_at > request_created_at)
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_post_visit_followups_pending
    ON appointment_post_visit_followups(
        status,
        expires_at
    );

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_post_visit_followups_appointment
    ON appointment_post_visit_followups(
        appointment_id,
        followup_stage
    );

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_post_visit_followups_risk
    ON appointment_post_visit_followups(
        needs_human_review,
        risk_level,
        responded_at
    )
    WHERE needs_human_review = TRUE;

SELECT
    TRUE AS success,
    'migration_completed' AS result,
    'ساختار پیگیری بیمار پس از مراجعه ایجاد شد.' AS message;

parameters.content:
## فقط یک‌بار اجرا شود

این Workflow جدول `appointment_post_visit_followups` را ایجاد می‌کند.

جدول، درخواست پیگیری، پاسخ بیمار، وضعیت بهبود، درد، مشکل دارویی، شکایت، رضایت و سطح ریسک را نگهداری می‌کند.

بعد از اجرای موفق، Workflow را غیرفعال نگه دار.
